title: Operator: capability flags on GET /operator/health

investigation.trigger: standing instruction to keep shipping real, tested improvements to the Command Hub Operator Console
investigation.target: GET /api/v1/operator/health (services/gateway/src/routes/operator.ts) — already existed as a plain liveness check
investigation.finding: no route reported which of the six optional, env-gated Operator Console capabilities were live; an operator had to check each env var on the live ECS task def separately

fix.mechanism: extended the existing GET /health handler additively with a capabilities object, reusing each capability's own existing predicate function (isOperatorThreadsEnabled, isTurnMemoryEnabled, isSqlReadonlyEnabled, isBootstrapPackEnabled, isVtidSelfAllocateEnabled) plus the inline OPERATOR_AWS_READONLY_ENABLED check every existing call site already uses; every pre-existing response field unchanged

live_verification: not performed — no live task-def env-var state was inspected from this session; the next real signal is a real curl of GET /api/v1/operator/health against staging/prod reflecting the actual pinned flags
